description:
Ship a scalar `GrayQamMapper<S>` struct that implements `BatchMapper<S>` for the Gray-coded square-QAM preset family, using the preset's Gray structure to map bit-pairs directly to PAM levels without round-tripping through the general `ModemSpec` label-lookup path.

The preset `ModemSpec` itself (from `c87c5043`) already ships the canonical normalized constellation and bit-channel semantics. This task adds the concrete optimized scalar mapper that pairs with the fast soft demapper (`db1dda70`) and the SIMD kernels (`c5cee991`). The general arbitrary-constellation mapper lives in `b2c9c0f0`; this is its Gray-QAM fast-path sibling.

## Scope

- Add `crates/gf2-coding/src/modem/gray_qam_mapper.rs` containing a `GrayQamMapper<S: ModemScalar>` struct that wraps (or derives its state from) `ModemSpec<S>` preset output and implements `BatchMapper<S>`.
- Internally cache a bit-pair → signed PAM level lookup so each output symbol is `O(1)` relative to `bits_per_symbol`, independent of constellation size `M`.
- Constructor `GrayQamMapper::from_preset_order(order)` (and a generic `from_preset_order_with_scalar(order)`) that accepts `2, 4, 16, 64, 256` and panics on any other value with a descriptive message.
- The mapper's `spec()` accessor returns the preset `ModemView` so downstream code can treat a `GrayQamMapper` and the reference mapper interchangeably.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Public `GrayQamMapper<S>` struct exists under `crates/gf2-coding/src/modem/` and is re-exported from the crate's `modem` module.
- [ ] `GrayQamMapper<S>` implements `BatchMapper<S>` end-to-end: `spec()` returns a `ModemView` of the backing preset, and `map_bits` writes the correct pre-normalized I/Q symbols in symbol-major, MSB-first order.
- [ ] Output matches the corresponding `ModemSpec::gray_square_qam(order).view().point(label)` for every valid input-bit pattern; verified by a round-trip test for all five supported orders.
- [ ] Invalid `order` or mismatched `bits.len() / out_i.len() / out_q.len()` panics with a descriptive message.
- [ ] Preset bit ordering (MSB-half = I-axis Gray-PAM bits, LSB-half = Q-axis) is preserved; covered by a DVB-T2-aligned regression test (QPSK match against the legacy `QpskModulator` layout).
- [ ] Test matrix is green: round-trip, per-symbol-count bijection, panic tests for invalid order and length mismatch, property test over random bit inputs.
- [ ] `cargo test -p gf2-coding --release`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test --doc` are all clean.

## Out of scope

- Soft-decision demapping math (task `db1dda70`).
- SIMD kernels (task `c5cee991`; this task ships a scalar reference fast path).
- Public `custom_constellation(...)` builder (`3e3fe377`; already landed).
- Any changes to the underlying `ModemSpec`/`ModemView` surface (`c87c5043`).

## Notes

Model after the preset ordering locked in `dev/active/c87c5043-constellation-data-model-plan.md` §4.5. The `ModemSpec` preset already carries the required Gray-PAM scale factor (`sqrt(3 / (2·(M − 1)))`) and bit-channel semantics; the mapper just needs a small PAM-level LUT to avoid the generic `label → point` lookup.

Scope was redefined 2026-04-13 (project-lead, with user approval) because the original "add Gray square-QAM presets" scope was already fully delivered by `c87c5043`.
title: Add Gray square-QAM presets
